pairs.question: Nosne Christo procreati mammonae dicabimur et dei formam gerentes seruiemus saeculo?
pairs.answer: Absit ut caelestis ignis se tenebris misceat.
pairs.derivation: The martyrs' speech opens with a rhetorical question (Nosne... dicabimur... seruiemus saeculo?) expecting the answer 'no'; the very next line answers it with the deprecation absit ut caelestis ignis se tenebris misceat. Stripped the opening single-quote scaffolding from the speech and normalized capitalization of 'absit' at the start of the answer. Stopped the answer at the first full stop (line 62); what follows (Sit satis, quod capta primo uita...) elaborates rather than answers.
